title: unified-rollouts-auto-rollback-canary-ab-shadow-traffic
author: Alex Kim
release_notes: Add unified rollouts service: canary/A-B/shadow traffic routing; add automated rollback based on SLO regressions and quality checks; expose rollout APIs and Console UI flags; telemetry and alerting adjustments.
description: Summary: Implements unified rollouts and model lifecycle primitives: canary deploys, A/B splits, optional shadow traffic, and automated rollback workflows driven by SLO and quality regressions. Motivation: teams need a single, auditable rollout system that works across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments with consistent behavior and clear operational controls. What this PR does: 1) rollout manager core: adds RolloutManager service that owns rollout state, traffic policies, and health-driven state transitions; 2) canary and A/B strategies: traffic-split primitives with weighted routing, staged ramp policies, and per-route overrides; 3) shadow traffic: opt-in mode that duplicates live requests to a candidate model without influencing user-visible responses; 4) automated rollback: configurable detectors (latency SLO, error-rate, output-quality regressions tied to evals) that trigger automated rollback and optional post-mortem hooks; 5) telemetry: new metrics, tracing hooks, and alert rules for rollout regressions; 6) API and Console: rollout CRUD endpoints, rollout preview, and rollout progress dashboard; 7) tests and docs: unit/integration tests and a guide in docs/deployments/unified-rollouts.md. Backwards compatibility: rollout APIs default to safe mode (manual approval) unless an organization opts into automated rollbacks. Deployment notes: feature gated behind rollout.enabled flag and rollout.v1 schema. See linked Linear tickets ENG-4821 and ENG-4900 for design and SLO thresholds. Checklist: [x] design doc and Linear tickets linked; [x] unit/integration tests; [x] basic Console UI for progress; [x] telemetry and alerting; [x] docs. Risk: automated rollback defaults and detector thresholds are conservative; we will monitor first wave on staging and Canary 1 before enabling org-wide.
commits: feat(rollouts): add RolloutManager core and state machine
feat(api): rollout CRUD endpoints and validation
feat(routing): weighted router with canary/A-B/shadow support
test(rollouts): add integration tests for canary ramp and rollback
docs: add unified-rollouts guide and examples
